public_view.question: Can target-only point support recover a box yaw that the released6D head cannot express, while avoiding confident neighbor-instance fits?
public_view.evidence: Two sealed Drone cases have GT yaw near90deg, predictedlocalextent ratios near1, but6D outputs are axis-aligned. GT-only factor diagnosis separates yaw-dominated case1 from center/neighbor case2. These diagnostics are not online signals.
public_view.scope: Test-time geometry optimization of per-proposal latentyaw, no network-weight update; not to be presented as a new TTA algorithm on its own.
public_view.cohort: Existing9sample development panel, predictions frozen. No outcome-based sample selection; not a held-out result.
public_view.candidate: Keep source center and extents fixed. For source top10 proposals, derive a local point support set solely from predictedbox geometry. Estimate yaw with localPCA and optionally optimize rectangle-surface residual under fixed point resampling; no GT fields allowed.
controls: same point support and fixedsteps yawoptimization
public_view.necessary_discriminator: If optimization does not beat directPCA, count it as geometry calibration rather than a TTA optimization contribution. If yaw helps only firstcase and worsens neighborcase, reliability remains unsolved.
public_view.prior_constraints: Do not move center to increase raw point count; that could select a neighboring instance. Point support or stability alone cannot certify semantic identity.
public_view.readout: Original text-onlynoun score ranking unchanged in first test; report oriented7D output as an explicit model-interface extension. Score with official7D GT and independent OBB intersection.
public_view.report: Paired cases, center fixed, yaw change, support count/residual/stability, all negative tails; no label-derived gating or LR/temperature search.
public_view.budget: CPU9samples, one locked configuration, at most3optimizationsteps; no GPU reservation requested.
public_view.adoption: No current adoption. Verify self-supervised geometric support can recover orientation and distinguish neighborcase before adding trainable adapters or scaling cohort.
